units.source_text: 當然，這只是四處遊蕩喝廉價酒時候的事了。

en.t: Of course, that was only when we were wandering around drinking cheap liquor.

units.source_text: 總而言之，兩個人碰到一起時，怎麼看都像是變成了外形和毛髮相同的兩條狗，在下雪的小巷裡竄來逛去。

en.t: In short, whenever the two of us got together, we looked for all the world like two dogs of the same shape and coat, darting about through the snowy alleys.

units.source_text: 從那天起，我們重溫過去的交情，一起去了京橋的那家小酒館，

en.t: From that day on, we renewed our old friendship and went together to that little bar in Kyobashi,

units.source_text: 然後，兩條喝得醉醺醺的狗還一起去了高円寺靜子的公寓，並在那裡過了夜。

en.t: Then the two drunken dogs also went together to Shizuko's apartment in Koenji, and spent the night there.

units.source_text: 那是無法忘懷的悶熱夏夜。

en.t: It was an unforgettable, sweltering summer night.
